The courses strongest aspects is its clear structure, the two-stage feedback cycle that meaningfully improves each draft, and the mix of creative and reflective writing that builds practical habits. The course also exposes us to many different genre forms which enriches our perspectives and strengthens our writing. The emphasis on personal voice encourages originality rather than summary. On the weaker side, the course focuses almost exclusively on the blog format, so we don’t get to practice other genres such as analytical or argumentative essays, research summaries, or short presentations.
